name: Condatis
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Condatis is a British god. He was a minor water deity. His shrines stood at the point where rivers meet. The meeting of rivers was his sacred ground.

okr.objective: Condatis is a British water god whose shrines rose at river junctions.
key_results: Condatis is a minor British water god.
His shrines sat at the confluence of rivers.
His cult was tied to the joining of waters.
